import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {
    static boolean verifyCondition(int[] f, int p, int k) {
        for (int index = 0; index < p; index++) {
            if (f[(k * index) % p] != (k * f[index]) % p) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static int countConfigurations(java.util.List<Integer> f, int p, int k, int position) {
        if (position == p) {
            int[] arr = new int[p];
            for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
                arr[i] = f.get(i);
            }
            return verifyCondition(arr, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int value = 0; value < p; value++) {
            f.add(value);
            total += countConfigurations(f, p, k, position + 1);
            f.remove(f.size() - 1);
        }
        return total;
    }

    static long computeResult(int p, int k) {
        long totalGroups = 0;
        Set<Integer> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (int start = 0; start < p; start++) {
            if (!seen.contains(start)) {
                totalGroups++;
            }
            int current = start;
            while (!seen.contains(current)) {
                seen.add(current);
                current = (current * k) % p;
            }
        }
        long mod = 1000000007L;
        long exponent = totalGroups - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
        long result = pow(p, exponent, mod);
        return result;
    }

    static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1L;
        long curr = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * curr) % mod;
            }
            curr = (curr * curr) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(computeResult(p, k));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
